item.title: Newton County Schools announces middle school District Science Fair winners
item.description: Newton County Schools announced the winners of the NCS Middle School District Science and Engineering Fair. First-place winners will represent Newton County Schools at the Griffin RESA Regional Science Fair in February.

item.title: GRAHAM: ICE center cooling support for Collins’ Senate run?
item.description: I don’t know who in the Trump administration is upset with Congressman Mike Collins, a strong supporter of the president’s agenda for the country, but whoever it is hasn’t done Collins any favors in his effort to become the next United States senator for the state of Georgia.

item.title: Rep. Mike Collins announces 2026 Congressional Art Competition
item.description: Representative Mike Collins (GA-10) invites high school students throughout Georgia’s 10th District to participate in the 2026 Congressional Art Competition.

item.title: Lady Rams establish region lead over Grayson with 53-45 win on the road
item.description: Newton and Grayson battled on the basketball court on Tuesday for the first time this year as the two teams produced another pair of thrilling games.The first matchup of the day featured a rematch of the 2025 Class AAAAAA title game as Newton’s girls team looked to make it two in a row over Grayson.

item.title: State senate vote backs efforts to investigate campaign money pumped into Georgia
item.description: Millions of dollars of out-of-state campaign money flowing into Georgia could soon be more strongly policed in the wake of mysterious political TV ads and big spending on recent elections.

item.title: Newton Rams shut down Walnut Grove to open 2026 baseball season
item.description: A strong showing from the Newton pitching staff paved the way for an 8-2 win over the Walnut Grove Warriors to open the new season.The two teams started their 2026 campaigns on the Rams’ home field on Tuesday, but it was the hosts that had the control.Houston signee Chris Guillory took the mound for Newton as the starter and went 3.1 innings of no-hit baseball as he set the tone for 1-0 start.

item.title: Eastside Eagles rout Stockbridge 15-2 to begin Shane Griffin era
item.description: The Eastside Eagles baseball team went on the road to begin the season and dealt a 15-2 result to the Stockbridge Tigers on Tuesday.In what was the first game for Shane Griffin as the team’s head coach, it was an all-around effort.Levi Pickett and Jayden Bloodworth shared the pitching duties in the season opener and the two Eagles pitched lights out.

item.title: Social Circle council discusses future ICE center, one-way street
item.description: Editor’s Note: This story was written about a council meeting that took place before it was announced that ICE had officially purchased the warehouse in Social Circle.

item.title: CHANCEY: Beautiful, wonderful words of life
item.description: According to Oxford University Press, 2025’s word of the year is “rage bait,” which Oxford defines as “online content deliberately designed to elicit anger or outrage by being frustrating, provocative or offensive, typically posted in order to increase traffic to or engagement with a particular web page or social media content.”

item.description: Otis and his mom need your help.
